title: Admin Sidebar Responsive Drawer + Enrolments Table Scroll
content:
**B1 — Admin sidebar responsive drawer (Critical)**
Admin layout `AdminLayoutClient.tsx` currently renders a fixed `w-56` sidebar that is unusable below ~768px.

Pattern:
- Import `useBreakpoint()` hook from UI-010-D
- Below `md` breakpoint: sidebar hidden by default, shown via hamburger toggle
- Overlay backdrop (`bg-black/50`) when drawer is open
- Sidebar slides in from left with CSS transition (`translate-x`)
- Close on backdrop click + close on navigation (link click)
- State managed with `useState` (no external library)

**B2 — Enrolments table horizontal scroll (Minor)**
10-column admin enrolments table overflows on mobile. Wrap table in a horizontally-scrollable container with `overflow-x-auto` and `overscroll-behavior: contain`.
- src/app/[locale]/admin/enrolments/page.tsx

Risk: medium
Depends: UI-010-D (useBreakpoint hook)
acceptance: Admin sidebar collapses to hidden below md breakpoint (768px)
Hamburger button appears in top bar on mobile to open drawer
Sidebar slides in from left with smooth CSS transition
Backdrop overlay (bg-black/50) covers content when drawer open
Clicking backdrop or a nav link closes the drawer
Sidebar remains visible and unchanged on desktop (md+)
Enrolments table wraps in overflow-x-auto container on mobile
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
dependencies: UI-010-D: useBreakpoint hook must exist first
verification: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && Chrome DevTools 375px viewport → /en/admin → sidebar hidden, hamburger visible, click to open/close. 1024px viewport → sidebar always visible.
